title: Write the job description
description: Follows the company template and is pre-filled from the recruitment request. The exported file is attached to the job posting and is what the Hiring Manager reviews before signing off.
sectionLineHint: Each line becomes a bullet in the JD file.

actions.buildJob: Build job posting from this JD
actions.buildJobHint: Exports a PDF and opens the job form with the file already attached — no download-and-reupload round trip.
actions.fileStale: The JD has changed since this file was exported. Press Preview or PDF/DOCX to export again.
actions.previewNote: Opens the actual PDF that will be attached — not a redraw, so it looks exactly like the downloaded file.
actions.saveDraftHint: Saves the content and rebuilds the attached file — the old one is replaced.

errors.generateFailed: Could not export the JD file.
